responsibility: Declares diagnostics::paths::lazy_path, a path subclass that postpones creation of real event/thread data until queried. It exists to let diagnostics attach a trivial placeholder path to rich_location during analysis and only allocate and populate the underlying path when a sink actually emits or inspects it, reducing work for disabled warnings and other suppressed diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: This header is the type declaration side of the lazy-paths pair: it defines the lazy_path abstract subclass and its contract for deferred make_inner_path creation, while lazy-paths.cc supplies the forwarding behavior and tests.
